decisions.reason: After two years this close-to-core carpet faces a somewhat higher aspiration test, but with no visible sign of failure and enough slack in a growing market we would still keep it.
Its premium hand-knotted wool-silk positioning still fits our craftsmanship-led identity, so absent clear underperformance we would continue to support it despite niche-demand risk.
Because it overlaps with several other carpet launches from the same cohort, its pruning risk has risen, yet without evidence that it falls short of aspirations we would keep it for now.
This carpet remains the most exposed to rationalisation within the overlapping rug portfolio, but the lack of a clear negative signal still argues for retention rather than immediate withdrawal.
The swivel shell chair line remains close to the core business and offers broader applications and learning across models, so we would keep it unless results clearly miss aspirations.
